findings.title: Data Set integration is incomplete
findings.message: Meta Data Set should use the Shopify partner integration and Maximum data sharing, or have MOS-managed funnel tracking automation active.
fixGuidance: Or activate MOS-managed Meta funnel tracking automation for the resolved pixel.

findings.title: Hidden-cause / bait-style claims in ad copy
findings.message: The ad uses a quiz-style hook and causal language to imply there is a hidden reason behind a viewer's energy/drive changes, while also stacking testimonial-style anecdotes and survey percentages. That can be misleading unless the destination clearly substantiates the claim.
fixGuidance: Remove hidden-cause or deceptive urgency framing such as "secretly crashing" and rewrite the claim as a neutral, substantiated article hook.

policyTrace: The ad promises a hidden explanation and strong results before the destination substantiates them

revisionGuidance: Lead with neutral product benefits and ingredient information instead of 'find out why' or other hidden-cause hooks.
Remove personal-condition quiz wording that asks or implies the viewer's energy, drive, focus, or stamina have changed.
Ensure the landing page immediately substantiates any testimonial, survey, or outcome claim used in the ad.

findings.title: Image reinforces a personal-condition callout
findings.message: The creative itself asks whether the viewer is 'not yourself' and says that if their energy, drive, focus, and stamina have changed, they should find out why. That visually reinforces a personal health/energy condition and a diagnosis-style quiz hook.
fixGuidance: Replace or revise visuals that imply misleading medical authority, fake scientific validation, hidden harm, or direct personal-attribute targeting.

findings.title: Landing page does not substantiate the quiz promise
findings.message: The destination is a presales placeholder that promises a 'personalized energy and drive profile' but provides no substantive explanation, evidence, or matching support for the ad's hidden-cause hook. That reinforces bait-style framing.
fixGuidance: Revise destination copy so it is congruent, neutral, substantiated, and does not amplify hidden-cause or personal-attribute claims from the ad.
